caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular box with a hinged lid. The box appears to be constructed from woven materials, likely straw or reeds, and is decorated with a repeating geometric pattern made up of triangles, X-shapes, and parallel lines. The surface of the box is textured, with the woven elements creating a raised effect. The color palette is dominated by earthy brown and tan tones, with some variations in the shades of brown throughout the materials. There is a clasp and a lock in the center of the front side of the box, both appearing to be made of a darker material, possibly metal or leather. The box is positioned against a plain, light beige background. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the composition, focusing attention entirely on the box.
title: Cowhide Trunk
